props.animation_script:
// =============================================================================

// Fulgur Finis (bespoke). Parametric via a CFG object. Sibling of Ignis Finis.

// Dim the scene -> multiple blue lightning bolts rush downward onto the

// target(s), bottom tip landing on each target -> a large blue explosion at the

// end with a heavy screenshake AND a per-target token shake. doneHook fires at

// the explosion peak; then the dim fades out. Tier-3 "big spell" feel.

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const CFG = {"name":"Fulgur Finis","key":"master_fulgurfinis","dimAlpha":0.6,"dimMs":420,"undimMs":520,"shimmerColor":11691775,"shimmerAlpha":0.3,"shimmerMs":700,"boltCount":4,"boltSize":1.2,"boltSpread":0.12,"boltAnchorX":0.5,"boltAnchorY":0.5,"boltAnchorDrop":0.0,"boltAngleJitter":70,"boltStagger":110,"boltHoldMs":150,"boltFadeMs":240,"boltShakeMs":220,"boltShakePx":6,"maxBoltSfx":3,"strikeSpanMs":760,"explosionSize":1.15,"explosionMaxMs":1600,"doneAtMs":220,"shakeMs":640,"shakePx":13,"tokenShakeMs":520,"tokenShakePx":11,"fadeMs":320,"totalTimeoutMs":14000,"sfxBolt":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/ExecutionGET.wav","sfxBoltVol":0.5,"sfxExplosion":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/ExecutionGET.wav","sfxExplosionVol":0.75};

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][FulgurFinis][" + CFG.name + "]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.gen.fulgurfinis." + CFG.key;

const BOLT_URL = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Lightning/LightningStrike01_01_Regular_Blue_800x800.webm";

const EXPLOSION_URL = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Explosion/Explosion_02_Blue_400x400.webm";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const A = ctx.params.assets;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const S2W = (fx, fy) => WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(fx * W, fy * H));

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInCubic = (t) => t * t * t;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => { const raw = dur>0?Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/dur):1; try{fn(ease?ease(raw):raw,raw);}catch(_){} if(raw>=1){ticker.remove(step);resolve();} };

ticker.add(step);

});

}

function fullRect(color, alpha, z, blend) {

const a = S2W(-0.1,-0.1), b = S2W(1.1,1.1);

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.beginFill(color, 1).drawRect(a.x, a.y, b.x-a.x, b.y-a.y).endFill();

g.alpha = alpha; g.zIndex = z; if (blend) g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

return g;

}

function screenShake(ms, px) {

try {

const view = canvas.app.view;

if (!document.getElementById("oni-shake-kf")) {

const st = document.createElement("style"); st.id = "oni-shake-kf";

st.textContent = "@keyframes oniShake{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}15%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px," + px + "px)}30%{transform:translate(" + px + "px,-" + px + "px)}45%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px,-" + px + "px)}60%{transform:translate(" + px + "px," + px + "px)}75%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px,0)}} .oni-shaking{animation:oniShake 0.42s linear}";

document.head.appendChild(st);

}

view.classList.remove("oni-shaking"); void view.offsetWidth; view.classList.add("oni-shaking");

setTimeout(() => { try { view.classList.remove("oni-shaking"); } catch(_){} }, ms);

} catch (_) {}

}

async function loadVideo(url) {

const vid = document.createElement("video");

try { vid.crossOrigin = "anonymous"; } catch (_) {}

vid.src = url; vid.muted = true; vid.loop = false; vid.playsInline = true; vid.preload = "auto";

await new Promise((res) => { let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; vid.addEventListener("loadeddata",go,{once:true}); vid.addEventListener("error",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go,1500); });

return vid;

}

function playSfx(url, vol) {

if (!url) return;

try { const a = new Audio(url); a.volume = (vol == null ? 0.6 : vol); a.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (_) {}

}

function meshOf(tok) { return tok ? tok.mesh : null; }

function makeSprite(tok) {

const m = meshOf(tok);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(m?.texture ?? PIXI.Texture.WHITE);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);

sp.width = Math.abs(m?.width ?? (tok?.w ?? 100));

sp.height = Math.abs(m?.height ?? (tok?.h ?? 100));

// Match the rendered token's mirror: mesh.scale sign folds in Mirror-Horizontal + facing.

const sgx = Math.sign(m?.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const sgy = Math.sign(m?.scale?.y || 1) || 1;

sp.scale.x = Math.abs(sp.scale.x) * sgx;

sp.scale.y = Math.abs(sp.scale.y) * sgy;

sp.angle = m?.angle ?? 0;

return sp;

}

function makeHider(tok) {

const m = meshOf(tok); let on = false, tR = true, mR = true;

const guard = () => { if (!tok) return; tok.renderable = false; if (m) m.renderable = false; };

return {

start() { if (!tok || on) return; on = true; tR = tok.renderable ?? true; mR = m?.renderable ?? true; ticker.add(guard); },

restore() { if (!tok || !on) return; ticker.remove(guard); tok.renderable = tR; if (m) m.renderable = mR; try { tok.renderFlags.set({ refreshVisibility: true, refreshMesh: true, refreshState: true }); } catch (_) {} on = false; },

};

}

async function tokenShake(tok, ms, px) {

if (!tok) return;

const hide = makeHider(tok);

const c = { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y };

const spr = makeSprite(tok);

spr.x = c.x; spr.y = c.y; spr.zIndex = 8900;

try {

hide.start();

stage.addChild(spr); spawned.push(spr);

await tween((p) => { const d = 1 - p; spr.x = c.x + (Math.random()*2-1)*px*d; spr.y = c.y + (Math.random()*2-1)*px*d; }, ms, null);

} catch (_) {} finally {

destroyObj(spr); hide.restore();

}

}

try {

const points = (targetTokens.length ? targetTokens : [caster])

.filter(Boolean)

.map(t => ({ x: t.center.x, y: t.center.y, tok: t }));

if (!points.length) points.push({ x: S2W(0.6,0.5).x, y: S2W(0.6,0.5).y, tok: null });

// 1) dim the scene

const dim = fullRect(0x000000, 0, 7000, false);

stage.addChild(dim); spawned.push(dim);

await tween((p) => { dim.alpha = cfg.dimAlpha * p; }, cfg.dimMs, easeOutCubic);

// 1b) element-colored screen shimmer at initialization (mirrors Ignis Finis)

const shim = fullRect(cfg.shimmerColor, 0, 7100, true);

stage.addChild(shim); spawned.push(shim);

tween((p) => { shim.alpha = Math.sin(p*Math.PI) * cfg.shimmerAlpha; }, cfg.shimmerMs, null).then(() => destroyObj(shim));

// 2) multiple lightning bolts rush down onto each target

let boltSfxCount = 0;

async function boltStrike(pt) {

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.boltCount; i++) {

const isLast = (i === cfg.boltCount - 1);

const jx = isLast ? 0 : (Math.random()*2 - 1) * hPx(cfg.boltSpread);

(async () => {

const vid = await loadVideo(A.bolt);

const tex = PIXI.Texture.from(vid);

const nw = tex.width || tex.orig?.width || 800;

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

sp.anchor.set(cfg.boltAnchorX, cfg.boltAnchorY);

sp.x = pt.x + jx; sp.y = pt.y + hPx(cfg.boltAnchorDrop); sp.zIndex = 8100;

sp.scale.set(hPx(cfg.boltSize) / nw);

// vary the strike angle but stay within the top hemisphere so it always falls from the sky

sp.angle = (Math.random()*2 - 1) * cfg.boltAngleJitter;

sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

try { vid.currentTime = 0; await vid.play(); } catch (_) {}

if (boltSfxCount < cfg.maxBoltSfx) { boltSfxCount++; playSfx(cfg.sfxBolt, cfg.sfxBoltVol); }

if (cfg.boltShakePx) screenShake(cfg.boltShakeMs, cfg.boltShakePx);

await waitMs(cfg.boltHoldMs);

await tween((p) => { sp.alpha = 1 - p; }, cfg.boltFadeMs, easeOutCubic);

destroyObj(sp);

try { vid.pause(); vid.removeAttribute("src"); vid.load(); } catch (_) {}

})();

await waitMs(cfg.boltStagger);

}

}

points.forEach(pt => { boltStrike(pt); });

await waitMs(cfg.strikeSpanMs);

// 3) large explosion at each target + heavy shakes

const exSprites = [];

const exVids = [];

for (const pt of points) {

const vid = await loadVideo(A.explosion);

const tex = PIXI.Texture.from(vid);

const nw = tex.width || tex.orig?.width || 400;

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5); sp.x = pt.x; sp.y = pt.y; sp.zIndex = 8200;

sp.scale.set(hPx(cfg.explosionSize) / nw);

sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

try { vid.currentTime = 0; await vid.play(); } catch (_) {}

exSprites.push(sp); exVids.push(vid);

}

playSfx(cfg.sfxExplosion, cfg.sfxExplosionVol);

screenShake(cfg.shakeMs, cfg.shakePx);

points.forEach(pt => { if (pt.tok) tokenShake(pt.tok, cfg.tokenShakeMs, cfg.tokenShakePx); });

await waitMs(cfg.doneAtMs);

fireDone({ ok: true });

await new Promise((res) => { let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; if (exVids[0]) exVids[0].addEventListener("ended",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go, cfg.explosionMaxMs); });

await tween((p) => { for (const sp of exSprites) sp.alpha = 1 - p; }, cfg.fadeMs, easeOutCubic);

for (const sp of exSprites) destroyObj(sp);

for (const vid of exVids) { try { vid.pause(); vid.removeAttribute("src"); vid.load(); } catch (_) {} }

// 4) undim

await tween((p) => { dim.alpha = cfg.dimAlpha * (1 - p); }, cfg.undimMs, easeOutCubic);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][FulgurFinis]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

cleanupAll();

}

`;

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 14000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG, assets: { bolt: BOLT_URL, explosion: EXPLOSION_URL } },

meta: { source: CFG.name },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, "pseudo non-OK / timeout", result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();

// Arc Spark — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

(async () => {

const CFG = {"color":11824127,"coreColor":16777215,"travelMs":520,"orbSize":26,"trailEvery":34,"trailLife":340,"windupMs":320,"windupCount":14,"windupRadius":90,"impactCount":20,"impactRadius":130,"impactSize":12,"impactWebm":null,"impactWebmSize":340,"staggerMs":130,"shakeMs":380,"shakeAmp":7,"donePhase":"end","sfx":null,"sfxVol":0.55,"sfxImpact":"HitElectric","sfxImpactVol":0.6,"totalTimeoutMs":12000};

const ASSETS = {};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.prism-arc-spark";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Arc Spark]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const tgts = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter(t => t && t.center);

const prime = tgts[0] || null;

const S = oni.screenLive();

const E = oni.EASE;

const ctr = (t) => (t && t.center) ? t.center : { x: 0, y: 0 };

const home = caster ? { x: caster.center.x, y: caster.center.y } : { x: 0, y: 0 };

function centroid(list) {

if (!list.length) return home;

let x = 0, y = 0;

for (const t of list) { const c = ctr(t); x += c.x; y += c.y; }

return { x: x / list.length, y: y / list.length };

}

// Centre of the authored play area (the v2 conflict scene stage rect).

// A pull-back should frame the arena, so it wants a FIXED point: aiming at

// the caster turns a zoom-out into a pan, and aiming at a centroid makes the

// framing drift with wherever the combatants happen to be standing.

function stageCentre() {

const f = canvas.scene && canvas.scene.flags ? canvas.scene.flags['fabula-ultima-companion'] : null;

const sr = f && f.conflict ? f.conflict.stage : null;

if (sr) return { x: sr.x + sr.w / 2, y: sr.y + sr.h / 2 };

return centroid(tgts.concat(caster ? [caster] : []));

}

function playSfx(k, v) { if (!cfg[k]) return; oni.sfx(cfg[k], { volume: cfg[v] == null ? 0.6 : cfg[v], fadeAfter: cfg[k + 'Fade'] || 0, fadeMs: cfg[k + 'FadeMs'] || 400 }); }

async function fxWebm(url, x, y, o) {

if (!url) return null;

o = o || {};

return oni.webm(url, { size: o.size || S.wLen(320), x: x, y: y, angle: o.angle || 0,

alpha: o.alpha == null ? 1 : o.alpha, zIndex: o.z || 95000, parent: o.parent || null });

}

async function fxBeam(url, from, to, o) {

if (!url) return null;

o = o || {};

const dist = Math.hypot(to.x - from.x, to.y - from.y);

const ang = Math.atan2(to.y - from.y, to.x - from.x);

const r = await oni.webm(url, { size: dist, x: from.x, y: from.y, parent: o.parent || null, zIndex: o.z || 95000 });

if (!r || !r.sprite) return null;

const sp = r.sprite;

sp.anchor.set(0, 0.5);

sp.width = dist * (o.lengthScale || 1);

sp.height = dist * (o.thickness || 0.25);

sp.position.set(from.x, from.y);

sp.rotation = ang;

return r;

}

let fired = false;

function done() { if (fired) return; fired = true; oni.fireDone(); }

async function shakeTarget(t, ms, amp) {

if (!t) return;

const spr = oni.cloneToken(t);

if (!spr) return;

const restore = oni.hideToken(t);

const c = ctr(t);

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: ms, ease: E.linear, onUpdate: (v) => {

const decay = 1 - v;

spr.position.set(c.x + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * amp * decay, c.y + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * amp * decay);

} });

spr.position.set(c.x, c.y);

restore();

try { spr.destroy(); } catch (e) {}

}

function streak(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width, host) {

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.lineStyle({ width: width, color: color, alpha: 1, cap: 'round' });

g.moveTo(x1, y1); g.lineTo(x2, y2);

g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

(host || canvas.stage).addChild(g);

return g;

}

if (!caster || !tgts.length) { done(); return; }

const host = oni.layer({ zIndex: 93000 });

const glow = oni.radialTexture('rgba(255,255,255,1)', 'rgba(255,255,255,0)', { size: 128 });

playSfx('sfx', 'sfxVol');

await oni.particles({ x: home.x, y: home.y, count: cfg.windupCount, color: cfg.color,

size: 12, radius: S.wLen(cfg.windupRadius), life: cfg.windupMs, mode: 'gather',

blend: PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD, parent: host, ease: E.inQuad });

async function bolt(target) {

const t = ctr(target);

const orb = new PIXI.Sprite(glow);

orb.anchor.set(0.5);

orb.width = orb.height = S.wLen(cfg.orbSize);

orb.tint = cfg.color;

orb.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

orb.position.set(home.x, home.y);

host.addChild(orb);

const core = new PIXI.Sprite(glow);

core.anchor.set(0.5);

core.width = core.height = S.wLen(cfg.orbSize * 0.45);

core.tint = cfg.coreColor;

core.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

host.addChild(core);

let lastTrail = 0;

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.travelMs, ease: E.inOutQuad, onUpdate: (v) => {

const x = home.x + (t.x - home.x) * v, y = home.y + (t.y - home.y) * v;

orb.position.set(x, y); core.position.set(x, y);

const now = performance.now();

if (now - lastTrail >= cfg.trailEvery) {

lastTrail = now;

const d = new PIXI.Sprite(glow);

d.anchor.set(0.5);

d.width = d.height = S.wLen(cfg.orbSize * 0.6);

d.tint = cfg.color;

d.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

d.position.set(x, y);

host.addChild(d);

oni.tween({ from: 1, to: 0, duration: cfg.trailLife, ease: E.outQuad, onUpdate: (a) => {

d.alpha = a; d.scale.set(d.scale.x * 0.995);

}, onComplete: () => { try { d.destroy(); } catch (e) {} } });

}

} });

try { orb.destroy(); core.destroy(); } catch (e) {}

playSfx('sfxImpact', 'sfxImpactVol');

if (cfg.impactWebm) await fxWebm(cfg.impactWebm, t.x, t.y, { size: S.wLen(cfg.impactWebmSize), parent: host });

oni.particles({ x: t.x, y: t.y, count: cfg.impactCount, color: cfg.color,

size: cfg.impactSize, radius: S.wLen(cfg.impactRadius), life: 700,

blend: PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD, parent: host });

return shakeTarget(target, cfg.shakeMs, S.wLen(cfg.shakeAmp));

}

const runs = [];

for (let i = 0; i < tgts.length; i++) {

runs.push(bolt(tgts[i]));

if (i < tgts.length - 1) await wait(cfg.staggerMs);

}

if (cfg.donePhase === 'impact') done();

await Promise.all(runs);

done();

`;

try {

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 15000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS },

meta: { source: "Arc Spark" },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();

TDfsEA9gh8Pc6aUP.name: Overcharge
TDfsEA9gh8Pc6aUP.passive_description:
• Trigger When Bolt damage strikes the Lightning Prism, whether it lands or is absorbed

It immediately gains a Free Action, which it uses to cast Fulgur Finis on an enemy — and the discharge strikes harder than a normal casting.

It pays the spell’s MP cost as normal — at 0 MP it can no longer discharge.

props.study_text: A hovering shard of storm-glass that answers lightning with lightning — strike it with bolt and it discharges back at once, unbidden. Its facets crack under plain force.
